title: 第1851章 冥影重重困玄帝混洞吞天破万法第1850章 连败三皇震东域玄帝之名动星空
content_zh:
暗影冥看着林玄，目光中闪过一丝杀意。
他抬手，一股黑色的力量从他体内涌出，在他身后凝聚成一片黑色的领域。
那片黑色领域方圆数万丈，比之前暗影幽的领域大了十倍不止。
领域中充满了阴冷和死亡的气息。
领域内的一切，都在被那股阴冷的力量侵蚀。
另外两名暗影殿强者，也同时出手。
他们同样释放出自己的领域，与暗影冥的领域融为一体。
三片黑色领域相互叠加，形成一片更加庞大的黑色领域，方圆数十万丈，将整片星域都笼罩其中。
林玄站在那片黑色领域中，周围的法则，在被那股阴冷的力量侵蚀。连他体内的混洞，都在那股阴冷力量的影响下，运转变得缓慢了一些。
他目光平静：“有点意思。”
暗影冥看着他，缓缓开口：“林玄，这，是暗影殿的镇殿大阵——冥影天域。在这片领域中，你的修为，会被压制三成。你的法则，会被侵蚀。你的灵魂，会被腐蚀。你，必死无疑。”
林玄看着他，目光平静：“是吗？”
他抬手，体内的混洞猛然旋转起来。
恐怖的吞噬之力，从他体内涌出，在他身前，凝聚成一个数千丈的巨型灰色漩涡，不断旋转，吞噬着周围的一切。
那股阴冷的力量被灰色漩涡吸入，开始被吞噬。
但很快，更多的阴冷力量，从黑色领域中涌来，填补被吞噬的部分。灰色漩涡的吞噬速度，跟不上黑色领域的补充速度。
暗影冥看着那个灰色漩涡，冷笑一声：“林玄，你的混洞，确实很强。但，在冥影天域面前，你的混洞，也不过如此。”
林玄没有说话，只是静静地看着那个灰色漩涡。
黑色领域的力量确实很强，他的混洞虽然能吞噬，但吞噬速度，确实跟不上黑色领域的补充速度。
但，他没有慌张。

他抬手，混沌珠从他体内飞出，悬浮在他头顶。
混沌珠散发着灰色的光芒，与他身前的灰色漩涡，相互呼应。混沌珠的力量，注入灰色漩涡中，让灰色漩涡的吞噬速度，暴涨了一倍。
那些阴冷的力量，被灰色漩涡疯狂吞噬。黑色领域的补充速度，开始跟不上灰色漩涡的吞噬速度。
那片黑色领域，开始缓缓缩小。
暗影冥看着这一幕，目光中闪过一丝惊讶：“混沌珠？！你竟然有混沌珠？！”
林玄没有回答他，继续催动混沌珠，增强吞噬之力。
暗影冥目光一冷：“就算你有混沌珠，今天，你也要死！”
他抬手，一枚黑色的令牌从他掌心浮现。
那枚令牌和之前暗影幽使用的暗影令，一模一样。
但暗影冥手中的这枚，更加古老，更加强大。
他抬手，那枚黑色令牌，猛然爆发出一股恐怖的黑色光芒。
那股黑色光芒在黑色领域中扩散，与黑色领域融为一体，让黑色领域的力量，猛然暴涨！
那些阴冷的力量，变得更加浓郁，更加恐怖。
灰色漩涡的吞噬速度，再次跟不上黑色领域的补充速度。
黑色领域，开始重新扩大！
暗影冥看着林玄，发出一声狞笑：“林玄，看到了吗？这，才是暗影殿真正的力量！”
林玄看着他，目光平静：“是吗？”
他抬手，那株道衍之力的小树，从他体内浮现，悬浮在他身前。
小树通体呈白色，散发着柔和的白光。
小树的顶端，那三片嫩叶，在轻轻摇曳。

那三片嫩叶上的符文，在闪烁。
content_en:
Shadow Ming looked at Lin Xuan, with a hint of murderous intent flashing in his eyes.
He raised his hand, and a black power surged out of his body, condensing into a black field behind him.
The black realm was tens of thousands of feet in diameter, more than ten times larger than the previous dark shadow realm.
The realm is filled with the aura of coldness and death.
Everything in the domain is being eroded by that cold force.
The other two Shadow Palace experts also took action at the same time.
They also released their own realm and merged with the realm of Shadow Hades.
The three black fields overlapped each other, forming a larger black field with a radius of hundreds of thousands of feet, covering the entire star field.
Lin Xuan stood in the black field, and the laws around him were being eroded by the cold power. Even the hole in his body was operating a little slower under the influence of that cold force.
His eyes were calm: "It's interesting."
Shadow Ming looked at him and spoke slowly: "Lin Xuan, this is the shadow palace's grand formation - Shadow Heaven. In this domain, your cultivation will be suppressed by 30%. Your laws will be eroded. Your soul will be corroded. You will definitely die."
Lin Xuan looked at him with calm eyes: "Really?"
He raised his hand, and the hole in his body suddenly began to spin.
The terrifying devouring power surged out of his body and condensed into a giant gray vortex several thousand feet in front of him, constantly rotating and devouring everything around him.
The cold power was sucked into the gray vortex and began to be swallowed up.
But soon, more cold power surged from the black realm to fill the devoured parts. The swallowing speed of the gray vortex cannot keep up with the replenishment speed of the black field.
Shadow Ming looked at the gray vortex and sneered: "Lin Xuan, your mixed hole is indeed very strong. However, in front of the Dark Shadow Heavenly Domain, your mixed hole is nothing more than this."
Lin Xuan didn't speak, just looked at the gray vortex quietly.
The power of the black realm is indeed very strong. Although his hole can swallow it, the devouring speed cannot keep up with the replenishment speed of the black realm.
But, he didn't panic.
He raised his hand, and the Chaos Bead flew out of his body and floated above his head.
The Chaos Orb emits gray light, echoing the gray vortex in front of him. The power of the Chaos Orb was injected into the gray vortex, doubling the devouring speed of the gray vortex.
Those cold powers were crazily swallowed by the gray vortex. The replenishment speed of the black field began to fail to keep up with the devouring speed of the gray vortex.
The black realm began to slowly shrink.
Shadow Ming looked at this scene with a hint of surprise in his eyes: "Chaos Bead?! You actually have a Chaos Bead?!"
Lin Xuan didn't answer him and continued to activate the Chaos Bead to increase his devouring power.
Shadow Ming's eyes turned cold: "Even if you have the Chaos Bead, you will die today!"
He raised his hand, and a black token emerged from his palm.
That token was exactly the same as the Shadow Token used by Shadow You before.
But the one in Shadow Ming's hand is older and more powerful.
He raised his hand, and the black token suddenly erupted with a terrifying black light.
That black light spreads in the black field and merges with the black field, causing the power of the black field to surge suddenly!
Those cold powers have become more intense and terrifying.
The swallowing speed of the gray vortex once again cannot keep up with the replenishment speed of the black realm.
The black realm begins to expand again!
Shadow Ming looked at Lin Xuan and let out a ferocious laugh: "Lin Xuan, did you see it? This is the real power of Shadow Palace!"
Lin Xuan looked at him with calm eyes: "Really?"
He raised his hand, and the small tree with the power of Dao Yan emerged from his body and floated in front of him.
The small tree is white all over, emitting a soft white light.
At the top of the small tree, the three young leaves were swaying gently.
On those three young leavesThe runes are flashing.
